body_html:
Introducing Dericole, also known as DJ Ghost, a proud Veteran of the US Navy hailing from Georgia. DJ Ghost’s passion for music and entertainment shines through his ability to create new musical vibes and masterfully control the energy of any room. He finds the most joy in seeing the crowd come alive, especially during popular line dances like the Wobble, Teach Me How to Dougie, and Flex.

Currently, DJ Ghost is expanding his musical expertise as a student at the Atlanta Institute of Music and Media. His dedication to his craft is evident in his seamless blending of tracks and his ability to read and respond to the crowd’s energy. DJ Ghost’s performances are always dynamic and engaging, ensuring everyone has a great time.

Beyond DJing, Dericole is a talented singer and dancer, bringing an extra layer of entertainment to his shows. His love for music and performing is infectious, making every event memorable. Come catch a vibe with DJ Ghost and experience the electrifying atmosphere he creates!
